$comment: Signed-in resident pages on a mid-range Android over 4G inside LINE: LCP ≤ 2.0 s, CLS ≤ 0.05, initial JS ≤ 180 KB gz (D-179, docs/performance-budgets.md) — a hard limit. Measured as a 360×780 phone with the Lighthouse mobile preset on a mock build (NEXT_PUBLIC_LIFF_MOCK=1, API_MOCKS=1); the session comes from the mock API's seed refresh token, which the proxy turns into a session before the render (mocks/state.ts). The consent screen is covered by axe in e2e (it needs a first-use account, which a shared Lighthouse cookie cannot give). L2 adds invoices/[id], pay, receipts; L3 usage, lease.
